paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: Jesus is the light, and He doesn't ask you to find your way through the dark by yourself. He says, "Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life." (John 8:12) I spent years in the back of a junk drawer, so when somebody says light, I'm LISTENING. And this light isn't a flashlight with a dying battery, friend. It's a promise.

Now look at how He backs it up. He says His own testimony is valid because He knows where He came from and where He is going, and He is not alone: the Father who sent Him testifies about Him too. (John 8:14, 8:16, 8:18) Jesus doesn't speak on His own. He says He does "nothing on My own, but speak exactly what the Father has taught Me." (John 8:28) So when you listen to Jesus, you're not getting one voice, you're getting the Father's word, and that's something you can stand on.

Here's the weight of it, and I think it's a heavy part. Jesus says unless they believe that He is the One, they will die in their sins. (John 8:24) The good news is in the same passage: as He spoke, "many believed in Him." (John 8:30) So the question for you, friend, is simple. Will you follow the light? And hear me, this conversation isn't finished, so keep that apron ON.
